title: review: B4: promotion.FEATURES planner_routing, baseline Planner metrics, pool.toml [planner.routing] documented defaults and planner_shadow budget (P14, P18, P20)
spec:
Why: promotion.FEATURES (orchestrator/promotion.py:10-25) has no planner_routing entry and collect() no evidence source for it; baseline._metrics (orchestrator/baseline.py:95-121) carries no Planner metrics, so the Fable-only baseline the brief (P20) requires cannot be saved or compared; pool.toml has no [planner.routing] table and no planner_shadow budget although planner_router.load_cfg and planner_shadow read them.
What:
- promotion.py: FEATURES["planner_routing"] = {"table": "planner.routing", "key": "mode", "modes": ("off", "shadow", "active"), "default": "shadow", "evidence": "planner_routing"}. collect("planner_routing", root): rows = planner_telemetry.read_invocations(root) (guard ImportError -> {"n": 0}); n = number of rows with tier == default tier alias "opus" (plus shadow rows from planner_shadow.summary(root)["n"] reported as shadow_n); aggregate class_evidence over every distinct (decision_type, band, task_class, architectural) class present in opus rows via planner_scorecard.class_evidence(model=<[models].opus id>, ..., root=root, cfg=cfg): classes_noninferior, classes_inferior, classes_insufficient counts; first_pass_rate and fix_rounds/gate/review deltas averaged over classes with evidence; shadow_agreement_rate from planner_shadow.summary. evaluate() keeps its existing rules; a planner_routing recommendation of promote requires classes_inferior == 0 and classes_noninferior >= 1 in addition (never on token savings). report() includes the new feature automatically.
- baseline.py: PRIMARY gains ("fable_tokens_per_accepted_goal", "planner_tokens_per_accepted_goal", "fable_calls_per_accepted_goal", "planner_tokens_per_material_decision", "fable_share") sourced from planner_telemetry.accepted_goal_summary(root) inside _metrics (guard ImportError/Exception -> None values); these are lower-better PRIMARY metrics and never enter NON_INFERIORITY; compare() reports them like the other PRIMARY metrics; save() stores them under metrics. Existing baseline files without those keys compare as None (no crash).
- pool.toml: add a documented [planner.routing] table with every key at its default and a comment per key (mode = "shadow" # off = today's Fable-only behaviour; default_tier = "opus"; escalation_tier = "fable"; hard_complexity_min = 9; hard_security = true; hard_spec_review_request_changes_min = 2; hard_ambiguous = true; min_samples = 20; shadow_sample_rate = 1.0; fable_reserve_share = 0.2; jev_mode = "shadow"; soft_threshold = 0.5) placed after [planner.routes]; add planner_shadow = 1.5 to [limits].max_budget_usd. Comments name the consumer module per key (planner_router.load_cfg docstring table). No other pool.toml change.
- Tests: tests/test_promotion.py and tests/test_baseline.py extended (existing test names unchanged).
acceptance: tests/test_promotion.py::test_planner_routing_feature_registered_and_collected — FEATURES has planner_routing with default shadow; collect under a sandbox root with opus and fable invocation rows returns n, classes_noninferior/inferior/insufficient and shadow_agreement_rate; with no rows returns n 0 without raising

tests/test_promotion.py::test_planner_routing_never_promotes_on_tokens_alone — evidence with huge token savings but classes_insufficient only yields stay; one inferior class yields stay or demote, never promote; one noninferior class and zero inferior yields promote

tests/test_baseline.py::test_planner_metrics_in_baseline_and_compare — save under a sandbox root records fable_tokens_per_accepted_goal, planner_tokens_per_accepted_goal, fable_calls_per_accepted_goal, planner_tokens_per_material_decision and fable_share; compare between a baseline lacking them and one having them reports before None without raising and never lists them among non-inferiority flags

tests/test_pool.py::test_planner_routing_table_documented_defaults — pool.toml parses with tomllib; [planner.routing] holds exactly the twelve documented keys at planner_router._DEFAULTS values and [limits].max_budget_usd.planner_shadow == 1.5; planner_router.load_cfg(cfg) issues no notify

result.summary: Traced promotion.FEATURES["planner_routing"] registration, collect() (class evidence + shadow aggregation, ImportError/OSError tolerance), evaluate() gating (classes_inferior==0 and classes_noninferior>=1 required, never promotes on token deltas alone), baseline._metrics sourcing the five Planner PRIMARY metrics from planner_telemetry.accepted_goal_summary with exception-safe None fallback, and compare() correctly excluding them from NON_INFERIORITY while reporting before=None without raising. Verified pool.toml [planner.routing] parses via tomllib and matches planner_router._DEFAULTS exactly (12 keys) plus limits.max_budget_usd.planner_shadow=1.5. All three acceptance test bodies match the implementation's actual behavior. No defects found.
